goal: Predict bulk_modulus, density, tg for PVNL (*C[C@H](Cl)C[C@@H](Cl)*)

evidence.claim: polymer_rules.json:classes.PVNL.ff_note: PCFF via EMC (build-tested: PVC/PVAc/PVA all PASS). OPLS-AA was tried and failed to build for PVC and PVAc. A full-text-verified COMPASS (Class-II) study of neat PVC reports K=2.947 GPa at 298K, numerically overlapping PolyJarvis's own PCFF-measured K=2.7-2.9 GPa -- two independent Class-II variants converge on the same value, suggesting the ~20-35% K deficit vs the experimental band [3.5,4.5] GPa is a Class-II-family-wide limitation rather than a PCFF-specific bug; switching to COMPASS would likely not fix it. No field-override recommended.
OPLS3e GPU-based Tg for 315 polymers; validates electrostatics impact on polar vs apolar polymers. lj/cut acceptable only when backbone charge < 0.1 e.
evidence.citation: Afzal, M. A. F. et al. High-Throughput Molecular Dynamics Simulations and Validation of Thermophysical Properties of Polymers for Various Applications. ACS Appl. Polym. Mater. 2021, 3, 2, 620–630.

evidence.claim: Definitive protocol comparison: stepwise vs continuous cooling, temperature ranges, cooling rates for polymer electrolytes. Protocol: 40-540 K sweep, 20 K steps, 2 ns eq + 2 ns prod per step.
evidence.citation: Webb, M. A. et al. How to Determine Glass Transition Temperature of Polymer Electrolytes from Molecular Dynamics Simulations. J. Phys. Chem. B 2024, 128, 49, 11978–11991.

evidence.claim: High-throughput GAFF2 polymer MD; 1 ns NVT anneal 300→700 K; 10 chains ~10,000 atoms; LAMMPS; systematic Tg and density for 1070+ polymers. Primary reference for nchain, dp, and forcefield defaults.
evidence.citation: Hayashi, Y. et al. RadonPy: Automated Physical Property Calculation using All-atom Classical Molecular Dynamics Simulations for Polymer Informatics. npj Comput. Mater. 2022, 8, 222.

evidence.claim: COMPASS Class II MD Tg for PVC/DOP blends via density-based extraction; MD Tg consistent with experiment. Validates Class II FF (COMPASS, same family as PCFF) for vinyl chloride polymer Tg — closest direct validation for PVNL class.
evidence.citation: Li, J.; Jin, S. H.; Lan, G. C. et al. Research on the Glass Transition Temperature and Mechanical Properties of Poly(vinyl chloride)/Dioctyl Phthalate Blends by Molecular Dynamics Simulations. Chinese J. Polym. Sci. 2019, 37, 834–840.

evidence.claim: NOT MEASURED for this SMILES. No EMC trial build was run, so coverage is asserted from polymer_rules.json:classes.PVNL.ff_accuracy_prior='pcff' only; whether 'pcff' can type THIS repeat unit is unverified until the build stage runs.
